items.t: China's Auto Repair Talent Gap Grows as EV Boom Accelerates
items.s: China's electric vehicle boom is creating a shortage of skilled repair technicians, with salaries doubling but positions still unfilled. The WorldSkills competition in Shanghai highlights the advanced skills needed for modern vehicles.

items.t: China's Electric Car Repair Shops Can't Find Enough Workers
items.s: As electric vehicles flood Chinese roads, repair shops are struggling to hire technicians who understand both mechanics and software. At the WorldSkills competition in Shanghai, young mechanics showed why the job now demands programming skills.
